issues.decision: Complete source and signal QC by measurement.
Freeze development/evaluation roles; preserve this source-inspection history.
Baseline correspondence supported; pixel calibration and required labels unresolved; retain quantitative inclusion hold.
FB2315 local images and ABFs differ from FB2314; folder/table identity retained; archive payload equivalence still needs G1.
Six KX 30-second pulse sequences recovered; final frame alignment/QC and short-protocol timing remain open.
Local TIFF also has 1200 frames; oxygen switch times remain unknown.
Use 4 um particle diameter for all five microsphere recordings. Compatible controls remain R4 work.
Clarify nm200423-A2 preparation conflict before preparation-matched inference.
State association only; report preparation/acquisition confounds.
Local ABF headers verify awake-before-iso for FB2312/14/15; remaining pair timing and wash-in unverified.
Gas description windows are evidence only, with no approved analysis windows.
All seven calibration headers name oxygen/raw/calibration-ID channels; usable calibration and alignment remain open.
Expression-labelled BOI is support only; no spontaneous baseline pooling.
All 20 unmatched CSV sessions have local images; separate local import/QC required.
Fluorescence is optional artifact support, not automatic false-positive ground truth or BOI biology.
